contract.approval_reference: Current explicit owner instruction 2026-10-22: independently investigate M4 writer-tail and reader contention with bounded contained workloads; preserve all hard safety checks.
contract.execution_authorization_reference: Current explicit owner instruction 2026-10-22 authorizes bounded exploratory M4 measurements and remeasurement after material instrumentation changes, using fresh operation IDs and full containment; no retry after a gate failure and no hard-gate bypass.
contract.measurement_semantics: Within each arm, seed 8,192 Jieba-tokenized documents, run one compaction concurrently with four WAL-durable writers (8 Upserts each) and two search readers (32 queries each), then Flush and verify after reopen. Compare default compaction, the abort-on-change snapshot prototype, and the delta-rebasing snapshot prototype in alternating root-hash order. Rebase mode flushes pending writer deltas at publication, preserves post-snapshot tombstones, and replaces only the captured input runs. Record total writer wall times plus opt-in stage wall/CPU timings for normalization, state-mutex wait, WAL encoding/append, query-mutex wait, apply and auto-flush; record query wall times and timing-schema-v2 CompactionDiagnostics for initial lock wait, pending flush, locked merge preparation, unlocked merge build, publication lock reacquisition and publication work. Schema v2 requires all write-phase and compaction-phase timing fields. State-mutex wait is exact API lock acquisition time; merge_build includes streaming merge, reopen, and test-hook time. Residual wall time is not labeled scheduler time because it also includes other work. This 32-write/64-query, one-round-per-arm operation is diagnostic only: no stable-tail claim, no cause attribution beyond instrumented stages, no qualification or architecture winner. Any superseded snapshot compaction is reported as such rather than hidden or retried.
contract.risk_acceptance_reference: Each three-arm exploratory operation is descriptive only; shared-host pressure, one round per arm and test-scale workloads prohibit causal, qualification or architecture-win claims.
